values.website: A compact industrial router on MediaTek MT7628 with 4G dual-SIM, optional Wi-Fi 4, and OpenWRT Linux. Supports VPN, VLAN, and advanced routing for IoT, transportation, utilities, and remote enterprise sites requiring dependable always-on connectivity.
values.catalogue: A compact industrial router on MediaTek MT7628 with 4G dual-SIM, optional Wi-Fi 4, and OpenWRT Linux. Supports VPN, VLAN, and advanced routing for IoT, transportation, utilities, and remote enterprise sites requiring dependable always-on connectivity.

Dual 4G MODEMS
3+1 LAN+WAN
256 MB RAM
Wi-Fi 4 2.4 GHz
12 V DC INPUT

Made in India
4G LTE
Wi-Fi 4
32MB Flash

values.website:
Digital Signage & Remote Display Networks
Environmental & Field Data Collection
Secure Enterprise Backup Network
values.catalogue:
Digital Signage & Remote Display Networks — Supports reliable connectivity for digital signage, advertising displays, and information kiosks requiring centralized content management and remote access.
Environmental & Field Data Collection — Can be used in agriculture, weather monitoring, and environmental sensing applications to securely collect and transmit field data from remote locations.
Secure Enterprise Backup Network — Acts as a backup internet router for enterprise branches and remote offices, ensuring uninterrupted connectivity with VPN and advanced firewall support.
